acceptance_criteria.criterion: MenuConfig.statusLines is optional — passing no statusLines leaves all existing consumers unaffected.
When statusLines contains entries, each entry is rendered as two-space-indented fn() output followed by a single blank line before the command list.
When statusLines is undefined or an empty array, no blank line is injected and output is identical to current behaviour.
No new npm dependencies are added to cli-menu/package.json.
All existing cli-menu tests pass without modification.
